title: Robust Nash Alignment under Preference Uncertainty
abstract: arXiv:2610.00715v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Preference-based alignment methods typically optimize against a single preference model, and can therefore be brittle when pairwise preferences are uncertain: noisy, heterogeneous, or shift after deployment. To address these issues, we propose Robust Nash Alignment, a game-theoretic framework for alignment to uncertain pairwise preferences. Our formulation has a major learner seeking a policy with a large worst-case win rate against both an adversarial competitor and any preference kernel lying in an ambiguity set around a nominal preference. When the ambiguity set captures the uncertainty in preferences, the resulting robust objective of the game directly yields a certified lower bound on worst-case performance. However, we note this problem is computationally challenging to optimize, and to address this, we introduce a four-player primal-dual proxy game involving the leader policy, follower policy, adversarial kernel, and dual variable

translated_title: 偏好不确定性下的鲁棒纳什对齐
translated_abstract: 基于偏好的对齐方法通常针对单一偏好模型进行优化，因此当成对偏好存在不确定性（如噪声、异质性或部署后发生偏移）时，这些方法可能变得脆弱。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了鲁棒纳什对齐，这是一个用于对齐不确定成对偏好的博弈论框架。在我们的公式化设计中，主要学习器寻求一个策略，使其在与对抗性竞争者以及位于标称偏好附近模糊集中的任意偏好核对弈时，都能获得较大的最坏情况胜率。当模糊集能够捕捉偏好中的不确定性时，该博弈的鲁棒目标可以直接给出最坏情况性能的认证下界。然而，我们注意到该问题的优化在计算上具有挑战性，为此，我们引入了一个包含领导者策略、跟随者策略、对抗性核和对偶变量的四方原始-对偶代理博弈。
tldr: 该论文提出了鲁棒纳什对齐框架，利用博弈论方法应对成对偏好的不确定性，为最坏情况性能提供认证下界，并通过引入四方原始-对偶代理博弈来解决其优化难题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Robust Nash Alignment, a game-theoretic framework that handles uncertain pairwise preferences and yields certified lower bounds on worst-case performance, introducing a four-player primal-dual proxy game to tackle its computational optimization challenges.
